# `Browser.NetworkInfo.Internals`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo.Internals — the low-level Network Information port
surface: the closed outbound/inbound ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js`
request/subscribe wiring the high-level `Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo` layer wraps.

Importing this submodule discloses the same `js-port:network-info` axis as the
top-level module (the disclosure is keyed on the `Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo` path
prefix), so the raw port surface cannot be reached undisclosed.

## `JsCmd`

The ONE closed OUTBOUND port type: the whole outbound surface as a single
auditable object.

  * `Query` — read the current network-information hints once.
  * `Watch` — begin a hint stream: each `change` event delivers a fresh reading
    on the inbound subscription.

## `JsMsg`

The NARROW closed INBOUND port type — deliberately NOT the app's internal
`Msg`. Every variant the browser can push is enumerated, so the fold in the
high-level layer is EXHAUSTIVE and an unavailability can never be silently
dropped: it becomes a typed `Err`.

  * `Reading effectiveType downlink rtt saveData` — a hint snapshot.
    `effectiveType` is one of the connection classes (`"slow-2g"` / `"2g"` /
    `"3g"` / `"4g"`); `downlink` is estimated Mbps; `rtt` is estimated round-trip
    milliseconds; `saveData` is the data-saver preference.
  * `Unavailable` — the Network Information API is absent in this context.

## `request`

```ipe
request : JsCmd -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`request cmd` — hand a closed outbound `JsCmd` to the raw port transport.
The served first-party JS sink reaches `navigator.connection`; the reply arrives
inbound as a `JsMsg`.

## `requestOne`

```ipe
requestOne : JsCmd -> Task Error JsMsg
```

`requestOne cmd` — correlated one-shot `JsCmd` → `Task Error JsMsg`.
Routes through `Js.request` with the `inbound` decoder so the correlated
reply is decoded fail-closed by the same gate the `subscribe` path uses.

## `subscribe`

```ipe
subscribe : (JsMsg -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`subscribe toMsg` — the inbound subscription over the fail-closed seal
decoder. `inbound` IS the security gate; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is handed to `toMsg`.

## `inbound`

```ipe
inbound : Decode.Decoder JsMsg
```

The total, fail-closed decoder for a `JsMsg` frame of this capability.

It first requires the frame's `tag` to be `portTag`, so a frame of another
capability, or an untagged one, fails closed; the rest decodes as `inboundBody`.
